articles.title: New CFO Appointment Could Be A Key Moment For Victrex (LSE:VCT)
articles.summary: Victrex has appointed Adam Butcher as Chief Financial Officer and Executive Director, effective 15 February 2027, following an internal and external search to replace the interim finance chief. Butcher’s background in financial planning, M&A, restructuring and business transformation at Honeywell, Rolls-Royce, General Electric, Baker Hughes and Wood Group aligns closely with Victrex’s focus on operational change, cost efficiency and long term value creation.
